title: Post-seal CODATA check of the terminal inverse fine-structure ratio
statement: After V3 independently seals the exact terminal inverse fine-structure ratio, the complete NIST CODATA 2022 central value and stated standard uncertainty are converted to exact rational interval endpoints. The sealed ratio is checked for interval membership without fitting or rewriting it.
generation_rule: Generate the complete eight-axis post-seal relation, provenance, custody, row, exact-interval and no-extra-rule product.
grammar_boundary: All exact post-seal comparisons between the immutable terminal ratio and the one complete registered CODATA inverse-alpha row including its uncertainty.

choices.name: answer-only-scalar
choices.reason: An answer-only scalar erases the generated physical carrier.

choices.name: complete-fold-carrier
choices.reason: The complete Fold trace retains the observed physical distinction.

choices.name: imported-or-fitted-relation
choices.reason: An imported or fitted relation lets consensus or target data select the law.

choices.name: sealed-terminal-ratio-versus-complete-codata-interval
choices.reason: The immutable exact ratio is compared with both exact endpoints of the full source-reported interval.

choices.name: unbound-provenance
choices.reason: Unbound provenance cannot demonstrate which premises produced the result.

choices.name: source-bound-proof-trace
choices.reason: Every generated candidate and decision is bound to its exact source trace.

choices.name: target-readable-prediction
choices.reason: A target-readable predictor can copy or optimize against the measurement.

choices.name: capability-closed-prediction
choices.reason: The registered Fold instruction surface has no target or ambient host capability.

choices.name: proof-measurement-conflation
choices.reason: Treating an external decimal record as a proof scalar violates the measured-value boundary.

choices.name: separate-measurement-record
choices.reason: External values remain source-bound records compared only after sealing.

choices.name: selected-favourable-rows
choices.reason: Selecting favorable rows cannot falsify the relation.

choices.name: complete-registered-rows
choices.reason: Every favorable, unfavorable and tampered registered row is retained.

choices.name: finite-answer-lookup
choices.reason: An answer lookup has no successor certificate.

choices.name: one-successor-closure
choices.reason: The One base and generated successor preserve the relation at every declared finite depth.

choices.name: free-extra-rule
choices.reason: A free constant, scale or exception can select the measured answer.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: No rule beyond the admitted dependencies and forced relation is present.

exact_result: The exact terminal ratio 503846395469/3676744786 lies inside the complete 2022 CODATA interval 137.035999177 +/- 0.000000021.
induction_base: The sole registered CODATA row retains its source identity, central value and uncertainty.
induction_step: Any additional registered authoritative row must be appended and checked without removing or reweighting prior rows.
exclusions: no CODATA value accessible to the formal derivation
no fitted digit or best-match selection
no omitted uncertainty or unfavorable control
operational_witnesses: The sealed exact ratio is inside both exact CODATA endpoints.
The CODATA central value is retained separately from uncertainty.
The validation depends on the already admitted formal claim.
falsification_condition: The sealed ratio lies outside the complete reported interval, the source row/hash changes, the uncertainty is omitted, or a tampered comparison is accepted.
